positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and deployed an identity verification workflow requiring demographic validation before caregiver proxy access is granted; adopted by 335+ healthcare organizations and used 2.6M+ times by patients
- Integrated a government authorization API (Finland) with role-based permissions, replacing a binary approval model; enabled tiered proxy permissions and ensured compliance with national regulations
- Engineered backend infrastructure enabling designated patient emergency contacts to receive limited notifications as a company-wide initiative spanning multiple teams
- Owned features end-to-end: determined requirements with customers and stakeholders, designed solutions, implemented full-stack functionality, validated releases, and supported post-launch adoption
